column1: # yaml-test-suite: cases the suite marks invalid that this parser ACCEPTS.
# This plugin parses a documented subset of YAML on top of the deliberately
# lenient jsonic grammar, so it does not reject every construct the YAML 1.2
# spec forbids. This file is the exact, checked ledger of that leniency: every
# id listed here MUST parse without error, and every other `error` case in
# test/yaml-test-suite MUST be rejected. Both runners
# file, so the two runtimes cannot drift on error behaviour either.
# When the parser learns to reject one of these, DELETE its line — the test
# will tell you to. Never add a line to silence a regression in a case that
# Format: <case id> <TAB> <suite description>   (# comments and blanks ignored)
